name: The Office Congratulations
look: A faded snapshot of a young Michael Scott from The Office, played by Steve Carell, with a long mullet, a short-sleeved white shirt, a blue striped tie and a blue fanny pack, shaking hands with a smiling older man in a dark suit in an office.
use: An awkward, proud handshake used to congratulate someone, often ironically for a tiny or dubious achievement. The older man and young Michael are labeled as the two sides, or a caption describes the occasion.
slots: who gives the congratulations (older man, left)
who is being congratulated (young Michael, right)
examples: Me for showing up on time once
Me after my first visit in six months
